content.short: Earnifi is a Web3 notification platform that has alerted users to over $150 million USD since February 2021.
content.description: Earnifi is a Web3 notification platform that surfaces opportunities across the ecosystem. Since its launch in February 2021, it has alerted users to more than $150 million in potential value, spanning airdrops, token gates, and other on-chain events. With no native notification tools on Ethereum, Earnifi helps people avoid missing what they are eligible to claim and stay informed about openings across decentralized networks. From airdrops to token gates, Earnifi covers the opportunities you might otherwise miss.
